4. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that he does not intend to file rejoinder affidavit to the counter affidavit of the State.
The principle of non-traverse is invoked in the matter for the same.
5. The FIR of the matter was lodged on 8.2.2024 by Raj Kumar against the revisionist alleging therein that his minor daughter aged about 13 years is studying in class 7th.
The revisionist is a boy of bad character aged about 21 years.
He has been teasing his daughter since long.
He tried to stop the revisionist many times but he did not stop his activities.

In November, 2023 at about 11 p.m. he lured his daughter and called her in the neighbourhood and gave her some intoxicating material after which his daughter got intoxicated and then he threw her on the ground and committed rape on her.
His daughter could not understand anything as she was in an intoxicated condition and in the same condition, she was brought back and left at the door of the home.
He then while extending threats ran away.
Again on 6.2.2024 when his daughter was returning from the school, the revisionist caught-hold of her and asked her as to why she does not come to meet him and started talking in a vulgar manner.

When his daughter did not return back, he inquired about it from the school and came to know that she has already gone to home and then after about three hours his daughter reached home and told him about the version.
The report be lodged and action be taken.
6. Learned counsel for the revisionist argued that the revisionist has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is argued that the revisionist has been implicated in the present case since the FIR was lodged against the first informant of the present case and five others by the sister of the father of the revisionist as Case Crime No.371 of 2023 under sections 354-Kha, 452, 323, 506 IPC at Police Station Bhognipur, district Kanpur Dehat.
It is argued that the revisionist is a juvenile aged about 17 years, 1 month and 5 days.

It is argued that the FIR has been lodged after an inordinate delay as the alleged rape was stated to have been committed by the revisionist in November, 2023 but the FIR has been lodged on 8.2.2024 which is after about 3 months of the alleged incident.
It is argued that the victim refused her internal medical examination and as such the corroboration of allegation of rape is missing through medical evidence.

It is argued that the revisionist has no criminal history,
para 37 of the affidavit has been placed before the Court.
The revisionist is in Juvenile Home since 21.2.2022.
Hence present revision deserves to be allowed.

7. Per contra, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 as well as learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail in the present revision and submitted that the revisionist is a boy of bad character as would be apparent from the fact that even previously on 17.11.2023 he was challaned under Section 151 Cr.P.C. by the police.
The revisionist is named in the FIR and there are allegations against him.
The victim has also corroborated the prosecution version.

Learned counsel for the first informant while placing annexure no.1 to his counter affidavit submitted that the revisionist has posted his photograph on social media in which he is seen to be carrying weapons being fire-arm and sword, the same also goes to show that the revisionist is a boy of bad character.

The D.P.O concerned has in his report also stated that the revisionist is not in the control of his parents and he had given intoxicating substances to the victim for being given to her family members also.
The opinion of the D.P.O concerned is that the revisionist be kept away from people of criminal nature.

sentences.text: After having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the revisionist is named in the FIR and there are allegations against him of committing rape upon the victim.
The victim is aged about 14 years.
The revisionist is a boy of checkered history as he was previously also involved in acts of teasing girls.
9. In view of the above, the present revision is hereby rejected.
